privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.dataCollectionText1: When you visit the website: our service providers process technically necessary connection data, namely IP address, date and time, page visited, referrer, browser and operating system. To prevent abuse, we check your IP address against a block list on each visit; it is not stored in the process.
privacy.dataCollectionText2: For an account: email address, username and optionally display name, profile picture and short bio. If you sign in with Google or GitHub, we receive your email address, your name and, where applicable, your profile picture from them.
privacy.legalBasisIntro: We process personal data on these legal bases:
privacy.legalBasisLogfiles: Connection data and abuse prevention: legitimate interest in secure and error-free operation (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).
privacy.legalBasisRegistration: Account and use of features: performance of the user agreement (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR).
privacy.legalBasisCookies: Storage on your device: Section 25(2) No. 2 of the German TDDDG, as it is strictly necessary for the service you request; further processing is based on Art. 6(1)(b) or (f) GDPR.
privacy.legalBasisNewsletter: Newsletter: your consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR), which you can withdraw at any time; we keep the block list after unsubscribing based on our legitimate interest (point f).
privacy.legalBasisContact: Support and requests: performance of the agreement or legitimate interest in answering (Art. 6(1)(b) and (f) GDPR).
privacy.storageDurationIntro: We only store personal data for as long as necessary for the respective purpose:
privacy.storageDurationLogfiles: Connection data: only briefly at our service providers, usually no longer than 7 days.
privacy.storageDurationAccount: Account data: until you delete your account.
privacy.storageDurationReviews: Posts such as reviews, comments and articles: until you delete them or your account, or we remove them due to a violation.
privacy.storageDurationNewsletter: Newsletter: until you unsubscribe; the block list entry stays as long as needed so that you receive no further newsletters.
privacy.storageDurationSupport: Support requests: 12 months after the request is closed.
privacy.cookiesText: We do not use cookies for analytics, tracking or advertising. In your browser's local storage we only keep what is needed for the site to work: your login session, language, design and display settings, recent searches and dismissed hints. This data stays on your device until you sign out or delete it in your browser. Our service provider Cloudflare may set technically necessary cookies for security reasons, for example to fend off automated attacks.
privacy.sslText: For security reasons, this website uses SSL/TLS encryption. You can recognise it by "https://" and the padlock icon in your browser's address bar. Data you send to us then cannot be read by third parties.
privacy.hostingText: The website is delivered through Cloudflare (Cloudflare, Inc., 101 Townsend St., San Francisco, CA 94107, USA), which also protects against attacks. We run the database, user accounts, file storage and server-side functions on Supabase (Supabase, Inc., USA). Both process data on our behalf under a data processing agreement (DPA) pursuant to Art. 28 GDPR. Where data is transferred to the USA, this is based on the EU-US Data Privacy Framework or the EU Standard Contractual Clauses.
privacy.rightsIntro: You have the following rights regarding your personal data:
privacy.rightAccess: Access to your stored data (Art. 15 GDPR)
privacy.rightObjection: Objection to processing (Art. 21 GDPR, see below)
privacy.rightWithdraw: Withdrawal of consent at any time with effect for the future (Art. 7(3) GDPR). This does not affect the lawfulness of processing carried out until then.
privacy.rightComplaint: Lodging a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority (Art. 77 GDPR). The authority responsible for us is {{authority}}, {{address}},
privacy.rightsContact: To exercise your rights, write to us at:
privacy.thirdPartyText: We request title data on our servers, so your IP address is not transmitted. Images, however, are loaded directly from the providers' servers, so your IP address is transmitted to them, as the image could not be delivered otherwise (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR, legitimate interest in displaying title information):
privacy.thirdPartyTmdb: The Movie Database (TMDB): posters, images and streaming provider logos for movies and series come from image.tmdb.org. The servers may be located in third countries, including the USA.
privacy.thirdPartyIgdb: IGDB (Twitch Interactive, Inc., USA): covers and images of games come from images.igdb.com, including from the USA.
privacy.thirdPartyImdb: Links to IMDb (Amazon.com, Inc., USA), JustWatch, AniList and other sites: data is only transmitted when you follow a link. The privacy policy of the respective provider then applies.
privacy.thirdPartyStripe: Stripe: donations are processed by Stripe (Stripe Payments Europe, Ltd., Dublin, Ireland). You enter your payment details directly with Stripe; we do not receive them. Stripe may transfer data to Stripe, Inc. in the USA, which is certified under the EU-US Data Privacy Framework (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR).
privacy.thirdPartyNote: You can find more information in the privacy policies of the respective providers.
privacy.changesText: We update this privacy policy when our processing or the law changes. We will inform you of material changes in an appropriate way.
privacy.overviewText: We do not use any analytics, tracking or advertising services and we do not sell data. We only process personal data as far as necessary to run the platform, your account and the features you use.
privacy.dataCollectionText3: When you use the platform: your posts and activity, such as reviews, ratings, comments, lists, saved and watched titles, poll votes, followed users and notifications. Your profile with username, display name, profile picture, bio and published posts is publicly visible, including through our public interface (API).
privacy.dataCollectionText4: For the newsletter: your email address and the time of sign-up and confirmation (double opt-in). After you unsubscribe, we put the address on a block list so that you receive no further newsletters.
privacy.dataCollectionText5: For support requests, reports and applications for a press account: the details you give us, such as name, email address, message and details about your outlet.
privacy.dataCollectionText6: For moderation: reports, warnings and suspensions including the reasons, and for suspensions due to abuse the IP address concerned.
privacy.legalBasisModeration: Reports and moderation: legal obligations under Regulation (EU) 2022/2065 (Art. 6(1)(c) GDPR) and our legitimate interest in a safe platform (point f).
privacy.legalBasisDonations: Donations: processing the payment (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR) and statutory retention obligations (point c).
privacy.legalBasisAi: Machine translation and AI features: legitimate interest in a multilingual platform (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR) or performance of the agreement when you trigger a feature yourself (point b).
privacy.storageDurationModeration: Moderation data and IP blocks: as long as the measure applies and a complaint against it is possible.
privacy.storageDurationDonations: Donation records: for the statutory retention periods, up to ten years.
privacy.emailText: We send system emails such as sign-in codes, confirmations and password reset emails, release reminders you switch on on a title page, as well as the newsletter through Resend (Resend, Inc., USA). This involves processing your email address, the content of the email and technical delivery data. Resend acts as our processor; transfers to the USA are based on the EU Standard Contractual Clauses.
privacy.socialLogin: Signing in with Google or GitHub
privacy.socialLoginText: If you use "Sign in with Google" or "Sign in with GitHub", you are redirected to that provider (Google Ireland Limited, Gordon House, Barrow Street, Dublin 4, Ireland, or GitHub, Inc., USA). After you agree there, the provider shares your email address, your name and, where applicable, your profile picture with us (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR). Transfers to the USA are based on the EU-US Data Privacy Framework or the EU Standard Contractual Clauses.
privacy.aiText: For machine translation of articles, writing aids in the article editor and for completing title information, we use AI models through the OpenRouter service (OpenRouter, Inc., USA), which forwards requests to the respective model provider. Only the text to be processed is sent, not your account data. Transfers to the USA are based on the EU Standard Contractual Clauses.
privacy.thirdPartyAnilist: AniList: anime covers come from AniList's servers, which may be located in third countries, including the USA.
privacy.thirdPartyYoutube: YouTube (Google Ireland Limited, Ireland): we embed trailers and videos in articles in privacy-enhanced mode (youtube-nocookie.com). The player only loads when you click "Play"; only then is data sent to Google, including to the USA. The legal basis is your consent given by clicking (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR, Section 25(1) TDDDG).
privacy.rightComplaintOther: You can also contact the authority where you live; an overview is available at
privacy.objectionTitle: Right to object under Art. 21 GDPR
privacy.objectionText: Where we process data based on our legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR), you may object at any time on grounds relating to your particular situation. We will then no longer process the data unless we can demonstrate compelling legitimate grounds that override your interests, or the processing serves the establishment, exercise or defence of legal claims.
privacy.obligationText: For an account we need your email address and a username; registration is not possible without them. All other information is voluntary. No automated decision-making, including profiling, within the meaning of Art. 22 GDPR takes place.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.scopeText: These Terms of Service govern the use of the CritiCore platform at criticore.cc. The provider is {{operator}} ("we").
terms.minAgeText: You must be at least 16 years old to create an account. If you are not yet of legal age, you need the consent of your parents or guardians.
terms.registrationText1: Some features, such as reviews, lists, comments or articles, require an account. You can sign in with email and password, with a code sent by email, or with Google or GitHub. Your details must be accurate, and you must keep your password secret.
terms.registrationText2: You are responsible for actions taken through your account to the extent you are at fault. If you notice unauthorised access, please let us know immediately.
terms.conductIntro: The following rules apply when you use CritiCore:
terms.conductRule1: No hate speech, racism, sexism, queerphobia or any other form of discrimination
terms.conductRule2: No insults, threats or harassment of other users
terms.conductRule3: No spam, advertising or repeated self-promotion
terms.conductRule4: No manipulation of ratings, polls or rankings
terms.conductRule5: No deliberate spreading of false information
terms.conductRule6: No publishing of other people's personal data without their consent (doxxing)
terms.conductRule7: No automated access (bots, scrapers) without our explicit permission; you may use our public API under its terms
terms.conductRule8: Please report security vulnerabilities to us instead of exploiting them
terms.conductConsequences: If rules are broken, we may remove content or restrict its visibility, issue a warning, suspend your account temporarily or, for serious or repeated violations, permanently. We choose proportionate measures, taking into account the severity and frequency of the violation and your legitimate interests.
terms.contentText1: You keep the rights to your content, such as reviews, comments, lists and articles. By publishing it, you grant us a simple (non-exclusive), free and worldwide right to make the content available on CritiCore and through our public interface (API) for as long as it is published, to adapt it technically (for example for previews) and to translate it automatically into other languages.
terms.contentText2: You confirm that you hold the necessary rights and that your content does not infringe the rights of others. We may remove or block content that violates these terms or applicable law (see "Reports, moderation and complaints").
terms.contentText3: If you delete content or your account, the licence ends and we remove the content from our active systems. It may remain in backups for a limited time.
terms.reviewsText1: Reviews should be honest, fair and to the point. They reflect the opinion of their authors, not ours.
terms.reviewsText2: The following is not allowed in reviews:
terms.reviewsRule1: Fake or paid reviews and coordinated ratings
terms.reviewsRule2: Reviews unrelated to the rated title
terms.copyrightText1: Respect the intellectual property of others. You may only publish copyrighted material if you are entitled to do so.
terms.copyrightText2: Rights holders can report infringements using our copyright notice form (DMCA) or by email to {{email}}. We review every notice and remove infringing content without delay once we become aware of it.
terms.pressAccountsText1: Verified press accounts can publish articles. We decide on verification and may revoke it in case of misuse.
terms.pressAccountsText2: Articles from press accounts must follow recognised journalistic principles (Section 19 of the German Interstate Media Treaty): news must be checked carefully for content, origin and truth before publication, opinion pieces must be labelled as such, and advertising or paid partnerships must be recognisable.
terms.thirdPartyText1: Title information and images come from third-party providers, mainly TMDB, IGDB and AniList. We do not guarantee that they are correct, complete or up to date.
terms.thirdPartyText2: Posters, artwork and images of titles come from the respective studios and publishers and are used for editorial coverage.
terms.liabilityText1: We are liable without limitation for intent and gross negligence, for injury to life, body or health and under the German Product Liability Act.
terms.liabilityText2: In case of slight negligence, we are only liable for breaches of essential contractual obligations, meaning obligations whose fulfilment makes the proper use of the platform possible in the first place and on whose fulfilment you may regularly rely. In that case, liability is limited to the foreseeable damage typical for this type of contract. Otherwise, liability for slight negligence is excluded.
terms.availabilityText: We strive for high availability of the platform but cannot guarantee it. Maintenance, updates and technical faults may cause temporary restrictions.
terms.terminationText1: You can delete your account at any time without giving reasons, in the settings or by email to {{email}}. We then delete your data as described in our privacy policy.
terms.terminationText2: We may terminate the user agreement with two weeks' notice. The right to terminate without notice and to suspend accounts for good cause remains unaffected, in particular in case of serious or repeated violations of these terms or applicable law. In urgent cases we may act without prior warning; we will tell you the reasons.
terms.changesText: We may change these terms, for example for new features or changes in the law. We inform you of changes at least four weeks before they take effect, by email or at your next login.
terms.finalProvisionsText1: The law of the Federal Republic of Germany applies. If you are a consumer, the mandatory consumer protection provisions of the country in which you habitually reside remain unaffected.
terms.finalProvisionsText2: If individual provisions of these terms are invalid, the remaining provisions stay valid. The statutory provisions take the place of the invalid provision.
terms.scopeText2: You can read public content without an account. By registering an account, you agree to these terms. Conflicting terms of users do not apply.
terms.registrationText3: There is no right to registration.
terms.servicesText1: CritiCore is a free platform for reviews, ratings and editorial content about games, movies, series and anime. Information about titles, such as descriptions, images, cast and release dates, comes from third-party providers.
terms.servicesText2: Some features use automated processes, for example machine translation of posts into other languages. We keep developing the platform and may change, add or discontinue features where this is reasonable for you.
terms.moderationText1: You can report content that you consider illegal or in breach of these terms using the report function on the content or by email to {{email}}. We review reports promptly, carefully and objectively and inform you of our decision.
terms.moderationText2: If we restrict any of your content or your account, you receive a statement of reasons under Art. 17 of Regulation (EU) 2022/2065 (Digital Services Act). It names the measure, the facts it is based on, the rule or legal provision concerned and whether automated means were used.
terms.moderationText3: You can file a complaint against such a decision within six months by email to {{email}}. We review it again; the decision is made by a person, not solely by an automated system. You may also turn to a certified out-of-court dispute settlement body (Art. 21 DSA) or to the courts.
terms.moderationText4: We document moderation measures in a moderation log.
terms.donationsText: You can support CritiCore voluntarily with a donation. Payments are processed by the payment provider Stripe. A donation does not entitle you to anything in return or to specific features.
terms.liabilityText3: Users are responsible for the content they publish; we do not adopt it as our own.
terms.changesText2: Changes that materially affect your rights or obligations only apply with your consent. If you do not consent, the previous terms continue to apply to you; we may then end the agreement under the termination rules.
terms.finalProvisionsText3: If you are a merchant, a legal entity under public law or a special fund under public law, the place of jurisdiction is the provider's registered location.

pressPage.title: Press on CritiCore
pressPage.metaDesc: Guidelines and rules for press accounts on CritiCore. Learn about the Two-Article Principle.
pressPage.subtitle: Everything you need to know about publishing as a press account – our rules, the Two-Article Principle, and how to apply.

twoArticle.title: The Two-Article Principle
twoArticle.intro: Every new press account must first submit two articles in draft mode. These are reviewed by the team before the account is activated. This ensures quality and seriousness of content.
twoArticle.step1Desc: Write two complete articles (review, news, or feature) and save them as drafts. They will not be published immediately.
twoArticle.step2Desc: Our team reviews your articles for quality, content, and adherence to guidelines. After approval, you can publish independently.
twoArticle.note: The review usually takes 1–3 business days. You will be notified by email.

rules.title: Press Rules
rules.rule1Desc: All articles must be based on verifiable facts. Rumors must be clearly labeled as such.
rules.rule2Desc: Titles must accurately reflect the content. Misleading or sensational headlines are not allowed.
rules.rule3Desc: External information and quotes must include proper source attribution.
rules.rule4Desc: Content from other authors or media may not be used without permission.
rules.rule5Desc: Criticism is welcome, but personal attacks, insults, or discrimination are strictly prohibited.
rules.rule6Desc: Spoilers must be clearly marked, especially in reviews and news articles.

consequences.title: Consequences for Violations
consequences.text: Violations of press rules may result in warnings, temporary suspensions, or permanent revocation of press status. In severe cases (plagiarism, hate speech), an immediate ban without warning will be applied.

transparencyPage.title: Transparency
transparencyPage.intro: Who is behind CritiCore, how ratings come about, how we are funded and where technology and AI are involved.
transparencyPage.contact: Questions about this page? Write to us:

team.title: Who is behind it
team.text: CritiCore is part of the TGN News Network. {{name}} ({{tradeName}}) is responsible. The editorial team:

ratings.title: How ratings come about
ratings.community: Users rate titles on a scale from 0.5 to 10. A title's average is the simple mean of all ratings.
ratings.critics: Ratings from verified press accounts carry the label “TGN Press”. The database sets it automatically; nobody can give it to themselves.
ratings.external: The rating at the top of a detail page comes from the data source: TMDB for movies and series, IGDB for games, AniList for anime. It is not the editorial team's verdict.

money.title: Independence and funding
money.noAds: CritiCore shows no ads and uses no affiliate links. Nobody pays us for ratings or articles.
money.donations: We are funded by voluntary donations. Payments are handled by Stripe.
money.copies: When a publisher, distributor or broadcaster provides a game, film or access, a note box at the end of the article says so.

ai.title: Artificial intelligence
ai.intro: AI helps in three places. It does not write reviews or ratings.
ai.translation: Translation: if you read an article in a language other than its original, an AI translates it. The article then says “Translated from …”.
ai.tags: Tags and categories: for the filters under “Explore”, an AI assigns themes such as “Time travel” or “Found family” to titles, based on the data sources.
ai.tools: Editor tools: authors can use a spell check, wording suggestions and a quality check. They decide what gets published.
ai.provider: Requests go through the OpenRouter service to language models from Google (Gemini) and Anthropic (Claude). Only texts and title data are sent, no account data.

sources.fixes: We do not correct errors in this data ourselves. Every detail page links to its source, where you can report them.

press.title: Press and critics
press.text: Media outlets and journalists can apply for a press account. We review every application. Articles from press accounts follow the journalistic principles of § 19 of the German Interstate Media Treaty: opinion is marked as opinion, advertising as advertising.

moderation.title: Moderation
moderation.text: You can send any post, review or article to us with the flag icon (“Report content”). We review every report and remove content that violates the terms of use or the law.

tech.title: Technology
tech.text: The website runs on Cloudflare, the database and sign-in on Supabase. The status page shows whether all services are reachable. Our data is available through an open API.

hero.text: CritiCore is the review platform for games, films, series and anime. Independent, ad-free and in five languages.

ratings.text: Drag the dial to try the scale. CritiCore shows three kinds of ratings side by side.

adFree.title: Ad-free
adFree.slot: This is where an ad banner would go.
adFree.stays: Stays off. This space stays empty.

languages.title: Five languages
languages.text: Every article can be read in German, English, French, Spanish and Thai. If an AI translated it, the article says so above the text.

open.title: Open
open.text: You can fetch our data through an open API. The status page shows whether all services are running.

worlds.title: Four worlds. One platform.
worlds.text: The data on every title comes from IGDB, TMDB and AniList. The opinions come from the community and the editorial team.

team.statement: CritiCore is part of the TGN News Network. {{name}} is responsible for it.
team.join: Do you write about games, films, series or anime? Media outlets and journalists can apply for a press account.

join.title: Join in.
join.text: Rate what you play and watch, make lists and vote in polls. Free and without ads.

noAccess.title: No access
noAccess.body: The dashboard is for the editorial and social team and for admins.

adminOnly.body: This area is reserved for admins.

palette.description: Find pages, actions, articles and users

live.empty: No updates yet. New entries appear here automatically, no need to reload the page.

live.settingHint: A live blog gets running updates on its page. You write the updates directly on the article page.

jobs.title: Jobs at CritiCore
jobs.intro: We write about games, films, series and anime. These are the positions we are looking for help with right now.
jobs.loadError: The positions could not be loaded.
jobs.emptyText: Check back later or send us an unsolicited application.
jobs.initiativeText: Tell us briefly who you are and what you would like to do at CritiCore.
jobs.notFoundText: It has been filled or has expired. You will find the current positions in the overview.
jobs.previewNote: Preview: this position is not public right now (draft or expired).

admin.title: Jobs
admin.intro: Positions for the /jobs page. Only admins see drafts; published positions are online right away until their closing date.
admin.emptyText: Create the first position. It stays a draft until you publish it.
admin.saveError: The position could not be saved.
admin.summaryHint: One or two sentences for the overview and link previews.
admin.descriptionHint: Separate paragraphs with a blank line.
admin.emailHint: Leave empty for the general address.
admin.untilHint: After that day the position disappears from the page.

layoutPrefs.title: Home page & navigation
layoutPrefs.desc: Choose what the home page leads with and which sections are one tap away. Applies to this browser.
layoutPrefs.railDesc: Trends and newsletter next to news and articles (desktop only).
layoutPrefs.dockDesc: Up to {{max}} sections at the bottom on phones, always plus the menu. Everything else is in the menu.
layoutPrefs.dockFull: The bar is full. Remove a section to add another.
layoutPrefs.navDesc: Applies on desktop. Home always stays first.
